meta.name: Kaboom Animation Festival
notes: Festival: Kaboom Animation Festival (Utrecht / Amsterdam / online, the Netherlands), international animation festival created in 2019 from KLIK! Amsterdam Animation Festival and the Holland Animation Film Festival (HAFF) Utrecht. Editions in the official archive within 2017-2026: 2019, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026 (7 editions). 2020 has no edition in the archive. 2017-2018 exist in the Kaboom archive only as the predecessor festivals KLIK! 2017/2018 (and HAFF 2017), which are different festivals under other names, so they have no rows. Edition numbers are not stated by the archive, so edition_number is Unknown.

Primary source: the official website https://www.kaboomfestival.nl. Edition archive https://www.kaboomfestival.nl/archive/<edition>/ lists the programme in sections (h2 headings) with programme items; the programme page https://www.kaboomfestival.nl/program/<slug>/ of a screening block lists its films ('Showing in this program': title, director(s), 'Country, year', runtime, synopsis); a single-film programme (features) shows only title, duration and the festival's text.

Program = the festival's own archive section. Scope rule: a section is extracted only if it can be extracted completely as films - every item is a screening block with a film list, or it is a feature-film section (one feature per item). Sections mixing films with events, workshops, talks, exhibitions, games or live performances are left out rather than extracted partially. Extracted: Feature Films in Competition, Shorts in Competition, Features, Features voor Kids, Shorts voor Kids, Kids, Kaboom Kids, To Infinity and Beyond - Kaboom Theme Program, Festival Theme: Human Touch, Big Bang Shorts, Two Decades of Dutch Animation, Country in Focus: Belgium, Freakish Delights. Left out (varying by year): Immersive Media/Expanded Animation, Specials/Special Events/Kaboom Specials, Kids Specials, Focus sections (Aardman, South Korea, Artists, Comics, Folimage, Nukufilm, Poland, Masaaki Yuasa), 100 Years of Dutch Animation, Best of the Season, Myths & Fairytales, Live/Online events, Satellite events, Celebrations, Festivities, Installations, Workshops, Let's Talk, Exhibitions, Industry; Kaboom Games (video games, not films) and, in 2026, YASS Queen and Live Performances.
Counts: 1390 appearances (rows) and about 1365 unique films (title + director) over 2019-2026; rows per year: 2019: 244, 2021: 267, 2022: 169, 2023: 142, 2024: 149, 2025: 172, 2026: 247.

Fields: directors are the names printed in the block listing ('A / B' for co-directors), country list as printed (English), runtime as printed ('NN min.') or the programme duration for single-film programmes, synopsis is the festival's own text. The archive prints no original title, so original_title repeats film_title. For single-film feature programmes (e.g. 'Nayola') the programme page prints no director or country, so those fields are Unknown (63 director, 54 country, 167 runtime, 9 synopsis cells Unknown over all rows).

Premiere status: the archive prints no per-film premiere label; all rows Unknown. Awards: the official winners archive (https://www.kaboomfestival.nl/winners-archive/) shows only the latest edition in its static HTML, so jury awards could not be assigned to films for 2019-2026; award_received is Unknown for all rows (gap).

Section descriptions: only 'Shorts in Competition' is described by the festival's own text (the introduction printed on its competition blocks); the other sections have no section text and stay Unknown.

Wikipedia and other secondary sources were not used. Known gaps: sections left out by the completeness rule (see above), awards, premiere labels, director/country of single-film feature programmes, edition numbers; 2020 has no edition; the Kaboom film database 'festival-archive' (9,436 films) was not used because it has no per-edition section structure.

films.syn: Caught up in our human lives, we miss out on the amazing. On an airplane wing, a company of snails performs a wonderfully slippery choreography...

This film is for my aunt, she had breast cancer last year. I was depressed and did not know how to help her, so I make this film. The tapir in the film is myself, and I put the healing figure (Kareau) in front of the house, trying to cure her. I’m trying to discuss the certainty of hope (Kareau) and uncertainty of disease (Cancer) in this film.

films.syn: Separate projections combine, unifying, becoming whole. Twelve animated projections combine to develop a rhythmic dialogue exploring the intrinsic relationship between sound and image using 16mm film, paint and a projector. Responding to a hand-drawn soundtrack, each projection is individually created by painting and scratching directly on 16mm film stock.

I discuss it with my father: a hunter, of course. But my mother also has a thing or two to say...” (Marcel Barelli)

films.t: Desire on the Surface of the Skin
films.syn: Desire on the Surface of the Skin is an abstract visual poem exploring desire and touch. The images focus on the viscosity of ink staining paper, flowing and troubling the clarity of water. The film compares paper to the surface of skin and studies the textural experience of touch by the bursting of colour. The extreme enlargement in the animation creates an intimate relationship with the pigment.

The producing part itself is not always as clean as we hope, yet we turn the blind eye as long as the end product looks desirable enough. The film plays with the fantasy of making food and about the satisfaction we get when having delicious products.

"Maria is love and care." An animation film as unsettling and uncanny as The Wolf House only comes around once in a while. A dark and hellish fever dream dubbed "the darkest animated movie ever made" by IndieWire, Cristóbal Léon and Joaquín Cociña's feature debut is a grim fairy tale, inspired by the harrowing case of Colonia Dignidad, an isolated and cult-like commune in Chile founded and tyrannically mastered by post-WOII German emigrant and professional madman Paul Schäfer, who would end up molesting children while turning the place into a torture centre at the service of the military dictatorship by Augusto Pinochet. Masquerading as a story produced by the leader of a sect in order to indoctrinate its followers, The Wolf House follows María, a young woman who flees the colony after being punished for letting three pigs escape and takes up residence in an abandoned house. From there on, as creative wolves, Léon and Cociña's let loose every safety pin, crafting a sinister visual journey of a physical and mental world that falls apart, destroying and renewing itself time and again. Filmed over five years, this stop-motion nightmare is animated to look like a single sequence shot. Everything is in a permanent state of transformation: the house, the characters, and our stomachs. Few films have so powerfully commented on the consequences of fascism. Enter The Wolf House , and you'll get a liquid Aryan trauma film that reminds us what evil is capable of.

The film tells the story of a father and son imprisoned in a death camp. The son, a trumpet player, is auditioning for the camp’s orchestra to enlarge his chances for survival. A firing squad will decide wether he is admitted. His father listens in from a distance.

films.syn: During a PowerPoint presentation, statistical diagrams are breaking free from the strait-jacket of their coordinates. A trip into the sensual world of statistics begins. Pie charts are melting, arrow diagrams twisting, scatter plots, bar graphs and stock market curves join in a collective climax.

Rob took one drag from this neighbor's crack pipe, just to get rid of the pain. He started using more and more. His bills started piling up. Until finally a letter arrived: his house was going to be repossessed. The day before the debt collectors would come he packed a tent, got on his bike and started cycling."I figured I’d just keep cycling until I died."

films.t: B R e a T H e
films.syn: Created during March 2020, this experimental stop-motion film reflects the anxiety of the artists involved as the anxiety around the COVID-19 virus grew globally. South Africa went into lock-down on Friday 27 March. Everybody working in isolation, the film was completed on 1 April 2020.

Jeanne was born in 1959 in Saigon. She enjoyed a privileged lifestyle, protected from the war between North and South Vietnam. Fascinated by horses, Jeanne rode a mare called Bach-Hông. But on April 30th 1975, the communists stormed the city.

Johann Sebastian Bach (1685-1750) is usually considered by musicians and audience as a holy, austere and frightening monument of perfection. This short movie is a 3 minutes insight into the life of the genius composer at the occasion of the renewal of his passport photos, in the spring of 1735.
Matt and his girlfriend Lara are living a peaceful life on a planet far away when all of a sudden they are blinded by a bright light.

Tagline Three stories of denied access and exclusion, bringing to light societies views on disability, gender and race in the most intimate spaces. Synopsis Stories of unexpected interactions and awkward moments, Bathroom Privileges is a short animated documentary looking at some of the difficulties people face accessing public bathrooms. Through a series of recorded interviews with contribut

Despite being born with wings instead of arms and with a beak where a mouth should be, a small girl embraces fantasy to escape the reality of her circus-bound world. A hand-drawn animated film about growing up as an outcast.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Two Decades of Dutch Animation)

films.syn: A baby bear gets lost to its mother bear and tries to get back to her.

Argentinian street artist Blu delves into evolution and its possible consequences in an unscientific wall-painted animation. Blu painted everything on sidewalks, buildings, beaches and pipes for this ingenious stop-motion film which is as grandiose as it is bold and critical.

Noise literally means unwanted sound. When many undesired signals accumulate, the wanted signal is suppressed and overtaken. But what if we tried to understand the signal as a whole rather than only focusing on the wanted signal? Noise is a big source of signals that could have a larger value which we have not yet discovered.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Two Decades of Dutch Animation)

films.syn: The seclusive retirement home Avondrood is a depressing end station. Fortunately, feisty elderly Gerda has one spark of joy: the weekly Bingo night. When she is one blank short of winning the game and the tiny ball suddenly disappears, she starts an absurd search for it in which she is willing to go to extreme lengths in order to get the outcome of that night's bingo game.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Two Decades of Dutch Animation)

films.syn: The tribulations and adventures of a young man wearing a cap, moving through a strange world populated by anthropomorphic creatures. In search of happiness although he doesn't know where to find it, he embarks on a philosophical and personal quest.
a little something for worried souls

The second part of a trilogy that started with White Tape (2010), Black Tape explores the theme of domination. Michelle & Uri Kranot's short shows how, in an entangled tango, the victim and victimiser dance, occupying the frame and the space between brushstrokes. It is based on news and documentary footage, exploring the implications of life under occupation.
What does a blind person see what i don't see. The animation is a short trip as how a blind person would make it.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Two Decades of Dutch Animation)

films.syn: Lèvres bleues is interested in using synthetic image to reconstruct the memory of a loving moment.
a boy conjures the stars out of yogurt.

Bru and Boegie are two best friends (one white guy - Bru, and one black guy - Boegie) in underpants who live in South Africa and get up to nonsense. But Bru and Boegie need to think bigger to get people to watch their shorts online, so they make South Africa's first full-length 2D animated movie.
A businessman walks into the elevator for another day at work...

De coming-of-agewestern Calamity toont hoe de jonge Martha Jane Cannary uitgroeide tot de legendarisch 'Calamity' Jane, een veerkrachtige heldin van het Wilde Westen. In 1863, nadat haar vader gewond raakt, moet ze voor haar broertje en zusjes zorgen en de huifkar leren besturen. Plots wordt ze ten onrechte beschuldigd van diefstal. Iets wat haar verplicht te vluchten en de gevaren van een gigantische en wilde wereld in de ogen te kijken. Een adembenemende en inspirerende western dat geen ziel onberoerd zal laten.

films.t: Calamity, a Childhood of Martha Jane Cannary (OV)
films.syn: Calamity tells the story of how the young Martha Jane Cannary became the legendary 'Calamity' Jane, a resilient hero of the Wild West. In 1863, after her father gets hurt, Martha Jane needs to learn how to take care of horses to drive the family wagon. Except she ends up being wrongly accused of theft, something that will force her to flee and face all dangers in a gigantic and wild world where everything is possible. A vibrant, breathtaking and uplifting western that will move every single soul.
A vulnerable boy works very hard to escape from a stark reality. He surrounds himself by a world of toys and games but as the truth starts to emerge his refuge might turn out to be a trap.

An anthropomorphic cat and dog, their images divided over 4 panels, receive an invitation for a romantic rendez­vous. When they eventually arrive at their destination after multiple moments of near-­interaction the lovers don’t turn out to be whom we thought they were. At the end it’s their abandoned spouses who meet and reveal the naked truth.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Two Decades of Dutch Animation)

films.syn: An abstract pursuit that leaves you gasping for breath.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Two Decades of Dutch Animation)

films.syn: Dani, a young babysitter, has just arrived to babysit the twins. Before the parents leave, they show Dani a sumptuous cake in the fridge which he must not touch. Once the twins are in bed, Dani, mesmerised by the gorgeous cake, returns to the kitchen. He opens the door of the refrigerator, and can’t believe his eyes: the cake has disappeared. He begins an obsessive and surrealist search all over t

A chromophobe army invades a harmless town, wiping all colour out. Luckily, resistance appears in the shape of a scarlet jester who restores the reign of colour using his chromatic trickery. Chromophobia - an unmistakable and universal political allegory - meant Raoul Servais' international breakthrough and is a prime example of his antimilitarism that emerged as one of the key themes throughout his work.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Country in Focus: Belgium)

films.syn: Educational short about Apartheid

films.t: Clipphanger: Why Do Girls Get Their Period?
films.syn: Starting at puberty, women experience menstruation every month until the menopause. When the egg in the uterus does not get fertilised, the uterus clears the mucous membrane through the nearest exit. Luckily there are good pals like tampon, sanitary pad, and menstrual cup to help out.
Experimental film about a strange town with strange people. The film is mostly constructed from drawings that children have made during a drawing workshop.

In this love letter to artists, their art and its audience, one filmmaker is confronted with rejection after rejection untill at last a beautiful fig tree bears sweet fruits. “Conversations with a Whale” was created directly under the camera lens, using various analogue animation techniques.

An old Cosmonaut lives the same kind of life now in his flat in a concrete panel apartment building as he did in his youth in a space station. As before, he still carries out heroic missions and misses his close relatives, who he left behind on his home planet. His close relatives see the situation altogether differently. Is this old man capable of coming to grips with the norms that apply in soci
CROPS is a stop motion film on centre pivot irrigation in the USA, using over 1000 circles, captured and cropped in Google Earth. Long water-sprinkler arms rotate around a central pivot.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Two Decades of Dutch Animation)

films.syn: On a long and dusty road a routine cruise patrol spirals totally out of control.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Two Decades of Dutch Animation)

films.syn: A dayfly is born at 0 o'clock and dies at 0 o'clock the next day. It in a short day, inadvertently passed many people's lives.

The award-winning official music video of Dutch rockband De Staat's Witch Doctor taken from the album I_CON. It features a mesmerizing performance in an ash-grey environment, abundant special effects, a lot of steroids and a spectacular mass choreography.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Two Decades of Dutch Animation)

films.syn: Straight monochrome image is transformed into a dramatic, silent spectacle where the colour subtly melts and solidifies lines and transfusing conical shapes. Colours eventually lose intensity, leaving only the basic structure, the "skeleton" picture. For this computer abstract film, Vegter used Fourier transformation.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Two Decades of Dutch Animation)

films.syn: 'Depart at 22' is a poetic animated short about growing old and the fear of losing the beauty of youth.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Two Decades of Dutch Animation)

films.syn: It's the circle of liiiiiife. But of a dog's life.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Two Decades of Dutch Animation)

films.syn: The film features ten top dictators and a group of American TV and movie star dolls. The ‘doll-versions’ of these television stars were made for merchandising - the television industry’s own form of propaganda. The dolls use their ‘powers’ to eradicate several contemporary dictators, from the notorious to the obscure. Made as a commission for the Museum of Moving Image in Queens NY. With a soundtrack by Greg Saunier.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Two Decades of Dutch Animation)

films.syn: An absurdist meta comedy on the bizarre relationship between daily life and global news. Here, war is waged on the kitchen table while a man drinks coffee. Helicopters shred his newspaper, a drone fires at a plate of broccoli. A playful critique on the level of media saturation we're bombarded with.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Two Decades of Dutch Animation)

films.syn: Deep down in the swamps of Louisiana, Evangeline finds a deserted alligator egg and hatches it under her bed, unbeknownst to her father Levon.

In this hand-drawn animation a line is being extrapolated through a grid. When the line exceeds the boundaries of the grid, the process spreads to and reflects on its surroundings. Beyond each boundary the extrapolation of movement is causing deformation in a systematic but speculative way. Hypnotizing throughout.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Two Decades of Dutch Animation)

films.syn: A huge factory, powered by two sole workers on a tandem, produces an unusual result.

Amit discovered the sea in a diving course and fell in love. The quiet, the water, the calmness, nature- it all came together and the sea returned that love to him. Based on a poem by Zelda. A short film in memory of Amit Yeori. The film is a part of project A Face. The Day. A Memorial. by the Avi Chai Foundation.
Through a series of enchanting encounters, Fern discovers how to see the world from a different perspective.

A woman grieves for a futuristic world she dreamed of but never will know. In transit from an era of high technology to another one of low technology, she’s left with nostalgia of a time that never happened. The story is a metaphor of humanity, which must radically change its perspective, abandon its desire for high technology and unlimited growth, and invent new possible futures.
An informative, yet bizarre short about some of the most bizarre mating habits in the animal kingdom. What would our world look like if humans behaved like this?

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Two Decades of Dutch Animation)

films.syn: Feed Me is the 2010 graduation short by Niels Dekker about the constant feeding of one very fat lady.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Two Decades of Dutch Animation)

films.syn: Artist Matt Furie, creator of the comic character Pepe the Frog, begins an uphill battle to take back his iconic cartoon image from those who used it for their own purposes.
Rare, medium rare, medium, medium well and well done. Through intimate and personal stories, five women share their experiences in relation to the body, from childhood to old age.
There was a pyrotechnican who launched a very big fireworks.The little flying squirrels challenge her. They perform miracles beyond their scale. This animation that gives people courage.

The impact of communism was huge. The destiny of orphans was taken from foster care to an institutional care. The animated document with the testimony of the man who grew up in the constitution and the woman who solves the problem from the outside, shows that despite 30 years of freedom from communism, Czech Republic still desperately needs a revolution in this area.

Freeze frame: the most absurd technique since the invention of the moving image. Through an elaborate process of duplicating the same image over and over again, it creates the illusion of stillness.In this stop motion film, identical figures perform the hopeless task of preserving blocks of ice. The repetitive movements reanimate the animals captured inside.

East Germany, 1989. Twelve-year-old Fritzi lovingly takes care of her best friend Sophie's little dog Sputnik, while Sophie's family is on a summer vacation in Hungary. When Sophie doesn't come back from vacation, Fritzi and Sputnik set out in search of her. An animated adventure that looks at the social changes of '89 through the eyes of a teenager.

films.t: From the Big Bang to Tuesday Morning
films.syn: Propelled by Claude Cloutier’s signature drawing style and absurdist humour, this animated short offers an overview of the evolution of life on Earth from rock to human, with some surprising twists in between.
There is a small puppy among the people. The dog reacts to everything, but no one concerns about the dog.

Travelling through the thoughts of Lucas, a man who is afraid of losing his masculinity after eating a pink fruit. This dialogue-free movie is about insecurity, it’s juicy and a bit erotic. Expect fast and organic movements, transitions and metamorphosis.

Sunday, Fulesee. Two people go diving in a lake. They understand each other without a word, everything seems ok. But the dive leads them not only to fish and into darkness, it also reaches into the depths of their souls. At 30 metres below the surface, fears and stories for which they cannot find any signs in diving language suddenly rise up.

We follow our gardener who is busy doing his things in the green house. Actually, he is taking care of the bumblebee living there, surrounded by plants. Watching the sweet relationship they have, we learn how important it is to make sure the bumblebees have everything they need so they can help us grow tomatoes all year long in a cold country like Lithuania.

One night, Reine, a young loner, sees within the urban choas a mystical oneness that seems alive, like some sort of guide. A collaborative effort with - among others - Belgian cartoonist Brecht Evens, Genius Loci is an elusive trip, ripe with influences, that draws you in like few short films do.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Country in Focus: Belgium)

films.syn: Gerard has some traditions that he will never let go.

films.t: Gerrit van Dijk – Counting My Drawings
films.syn: Emma Westermann's documentary shows the final six months in the life of Dutch animation grandmaster Gerrit van Dijk. Every night, he makes one drawing for his last animation films. A cinematic testament to one of the most distinguished Dutch film artists of our times.
A small ball will seek its place in the world around it.

WEI-ROU is a girl in the elementary school, who is still naïve and innocent but has begun to think on her own. The conception of being good and behaved, particularly to ignorant children, becomes the criterion of the society, which will accompany their growth an d shackle them throughout their lives.

This is a 150 degrees opening film for the Gouda Cheese Experience, projected inside an enormous Gouda cheese. It takes the Gouda Cheese Experience visitors on a short journey in the world of Gouda Cheese and introduces them to their host Ralfie, who will guide them throughout the rest of the experience.

After a traumatic encounter, a young, gay Egyptian joins the LGBT rights movement. When his safety is jeopardized, he must choose whether to stay in the country he loves or seek asylum elsewhere as a refugee. HALF A LIFE is a timely story of activism and hope, set in the increasingly dangerous, oppressive, and unstable social climate of Egypt today.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Two Decades of Dutch Animation)

films.syn: Stop-motion promo for TV channel Veronica, a dollhouse with elements from The Conjuring, Annabelle, It, Exorcist, VVitch and Halloween.
My story is about imagination. About the imagination which has been chained for so long, and set free with so much strength.
In the shop of a chocolate factory, four rabbits trade their kind look for bandanas and gangster style golden chains. They leave to deliver a ransom to deliver their boss.
Are you buying? A short film about the world we live in and choices we make.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Two Decades of Dutch Animation)

films.syn: Trapped in Damascus, surrounded by war, a lonely man becomes increasingly lost in his fantasies of fleeing and the inner dialogues with his dog.
A little dude called Helpiman comes across three people in the desert who are in need of Help. Helpiman is here to help!

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Two Decades of Dutch Animation)

films.syn: Crackling sugar skies and sweet cookies dancing their ritual to tribal drums of purity. "Her Cookie" is a celebration of femininity, sparkling in the dark. Shouting against food waste.
A little ugly chihuahua thinks his life will get better when he gets adopted from the pound, but will his new life get better, or take a turn for the worst?
A form of nature.
Ace is having a hot flash, and she’s about to go live on local television. How one woman tries to keep her cool when one type of flash leads to another.
Some beverages are refreshing in more ways than one. A cup of tea never tasted so good like as in this sensual short.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Two Decades of Dutch Animation)

films.syn: A very infertile husband is so desperate to have a baby that he actually treats the liposuction fat from his wife as his baby.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Two Decades of Dutch Animation)

films.t: How My Grandmother Became a Chair
films.syn: تفقد الجدة حواسها، الواحدة تلو الأخرى حتى تتحول بالنهاية إلى كرسي خشبي. خلال فترة تحولها يتبين للجدة أن خادمتها ليست الوحش الذي كانت تظنه بل على العكس، هي العائلة الحقيقية التي لا طالما بحثت عنها.

“How to Disappear” is an anti-war movie in the true sense of the word, searching for possibilities for peace in the most unlikely place of a war game. It’s a tribute to disobedience and desertion - in both digital and physical-real warfare.

The bears want to cook something they've never eaten before. They find a recipe in a cookbook for truffles - rare mushrooms said to have an indescribable taste. Can they manage to find them on their own?

A football hooligan feels unconditional love for his club. However, being gay, he has to hide his identity in order to survive in this world that is so precious to him. A tale of love for the game and the loneliness of the soul.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Two Decades of Dutch Animation)

films.syn: In this ultrashort animated film, we follow an octopus who is a clean-up neat-freak. But sometimes, even though you have so many arms, you still cannot reach what you are aiming for.
Music video for the track “入侵” (Invade) by more reverb - mostly made with powdered charcoal and compressed charcoal.

The youngest daughter of a family of sloths rebuilds her parents' and three siblings' story. Behind the human normality of a family, the wild spirit appears in everyday life's details, turning everything into untameable memories.

An elderly man is looking after his paralyzed wife. Despite his old age and health problems he's doing his best to relieve her suffering. His daughter helps him, trying to balance care with her work. Award for Best Student Short at Kaboom Animation Festival 2022.

A brave boy goes hunting for the Jabberwock despite the warning of the old man. When the monster is beaten, it still looks like the story will end badly. Jabberwocky is a poem filled with nonsense words that don't mean anything, but, miraculously, you understand excactly what the story is about.

On the borderless map of a magical planet, little beings pick, brush, weave, fish and collect elements from their natural environment to sustain their life as a group. This essential balance turns to chaos once they misuse their findings to polish their individual appearance.

Writer Juan Tomás Ávila Laurel had to flee Equatorial Guinea in 2011, after going on a hunger strike against Teodoro Obiang's dictatorship, the longest lasting in the wordl. With him and his books we embark on a journey to one of the most isolated African countries. This is the story of an artist's soul lost in geopolitics.

Being kids of their times, these two girls are ready to do anything to promote their music and become the next media hype of the century! With uncompromising ambition these two artists strip their entire privacy, following the dictate of view analysis and dissection of their followers´ behavior. Reality and fiction frighteningly melt together. A new hype is born!

JUST A GUY is an animated documentary short film about love. Three women share glimpses of their affection, attraction and relationship with Richard Ramirez: A serial killer and rapist they contacted after he was convicted in the 80s. Through their perspective, we revisit exchanged letters and emotions that are as obsessive as they are hauntingly familiar.
My mother’s dreams have always been strong premonitions for important moments in my life. I rely on her dreams more than any religion.

In the Chinese dialect of Hokkien, "Kua Bo" stands for "cannot see". Affected by cataract, 60-year-old Tat Chuan has problems with his vision which he refuses to admit or treat. It is only after a huge blunder of seeing the lottery results wrongly that he willingly - but timidly - attends a cataract surgery.

Lamput is a gooey orange substance that escaped from a secret laboratory. Two scientists, Speces Doc and Skinny Doc, are trying their best to catch him. But Lamput, always a master of disguise, escapes right under their noses!
During a walk in the forest, a worried girl takes in her surroundings and uses her imagination to find inner peace.
A boy goes on an adventure visiting loved ones on his heart-shaped jetpack - with potentially hazardous consequences when his jetpack needs replacing.
An intimate conversation between one's true self and the body they've been given.

The animation shows the daily pattern of the prisoners and how they were treated by the SS guards. An aged man looks back at his imprisonment at Oranjehotel during the WWII. He tells about his experiences in the prison and in particular about his new cell mate Pieter, a persistent resistance fighter who became his friend during their stay.

Little Miss Fate lives in a world driven by fate. When the opportunity arises, she slips into the role of the world leader. Unintentionally she creates a monster, which greedily wants to suck up all the love of the world. Overwhelmed by the rapid development, she loses control.
Puss is not happy when the Prime Minister introduces a new cat to Princess. Deciding to run away, it’s up to Princess to find her beloved Puss and convince him to stay.

Wanda is riding her horse, when suddenly the horses' eye gets stolen by a flock of birds! She travels through a strange world and meets amazing creatures. Will she find the missing eye and return safely back home? Lost Eye is an animated music video, the story is told in both animation and song.

Evert de Beijer's final film was a computer animated short dedicated to the rich history of our world. Here, Lucy, a four-million-year old lady, comes alive in the imagination of a boy when he visits a paleological exhibition with his parents. She takes him on a short, colourful excursion to the prehistory, populated by exotic prototypes in the early evolution.
Sabine is looking for a missing image: a day that has left its mark forever and that everyone remembers but her. But maybe this absence is what allows her to move on with her life?
In a post-apocalyptic Spain, different tribes survive, struggling to gain control of the only livelihood that exists, a very low quality red wine.
Deep into a forest, a gathering of wild animals start a nocturnal opera, conducted by a squirrel.

In a world where life forms are assembled on a production line, our so-called hero is struck by a dream as he catches a glimpse of the precedent character in an atomic instant of the production process.

Hypnotizing pendulum sets a particular mechanism in motion. A figure appearing fragmentarily, space and a variety of objects form a rhythmic system of mutual dependence. Sound interweaves with image, creating music of repetitive events. What is the cause and what is the effect? A stop motion animation made with threads on a vaseline coated glass plate.

Nono is the only inhabitant of planet Pano. He lives happily and spends his days taking care of his small and beloved planet. One day, the unexpected visit of Be2 will alter everything and will have a big impact on Nono. Despite their obvious differences, both will find a way to communicate and, therefore, live together in harmony.
In a madcap musical, a catstronaut travels the galaxy looking for the meaning of life, when she encounters a space pup eager to help but only gets them into trouble at every turn.
Observe and discover creatures and how they interact with each other within an organic-mechanic micro-world.
Two polar bears are driven into exile due to global warming. They will encounter brown bears along their journey, with whom they will try to cohabitate.
This walk in the daily life of several psychiatric institutions, allows us to meet extraordinary people who let us enter their privacy.

On a crosswalk of the planet 'Gunja Doron-x'. Nonnonanni murdered a mother of a child because of her annoying child who kept crying loudly. Nonnonanni is sentenced to the worst punishment of the galaxy, 'MOM'. 'MOM' is a punishment to live as a mother in Korea for the rest of the prisoner's life. Now Nonnonanni is heading Earth.

Cartoon Network's Monster Beach follows the frightfully funny adventures of surd-siblings Jan and Dean. Enjoying an endless summer vacation, they have a monster good time on the island of lki-lki hanging out with their laidback uncle and a bunch of mischievous, thrill-seeking monsters.

A poetic portrait about how Petra, a 30-year-old transgender who was forced to suppress her true self growing up, gives in to her subconsciousness and starts her transformation to the beautiful woman she is today. This film was made as an apology to the director's nephew who was openly discriminated against by the family when he shared his sexual orientation.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Two Decades of Dutch Animation)

films.syn: Twenty years in the making, Mosley tells the story of a heroic thoriphant who has been separated from his parents as a child and has been working on a farm ever since. In order to save his family, he decides to rebel against a life of servitude. He embarks on a treacherous journey to find the fabled City of Uprights, where thoriphants once lived in peace. Imagine Eeyore from Winnie the Pooh leaving for a Moses-like quest. A two decade labour of love, this first official New-Zealand-Chinese co-production is a worthy all-ages adventure with everything a cinephile's heart longs for.

Visual trip through the distorting perception of the protagonist. Obsessive physicist in a world full of backpackers, observes a distant Nucleus emitting impulses. Rubbed up by the constant noise of the his neighbor's cat, which keeps him from his work, he glides slowly to madness. In a surreal desert, he is confronted with the connections between his the neighbors, the cat and the nucleus.

films.t: Mush-Mush and the Mushables – Save the Fun Tree
films.syn: Mush-Mush & the Mushables follows the comedy adventures of the Mushable community as together they put the fun back into fungi!
In a world populated by people without a mouth, a gory accident leads to the discovery a mouth can be created by cutting yourself. This unleashes an enthusiastic chain reaction among the population!

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Two Decades of Dutch Animation)

films.syn: A man and his dog show off their hilarious exercise routine.

One morning a girl tries on a pair of new pants, yet they don't quite fit her. More precisely, they are impossible to zip. The girl is bewildered. In the mirror she sees herself like the fattest piglet the world has seen. She decides to go on a strict diet as quickly as possible. No sweets, no sodas, just water with an occasional lemon. The plan goes quite well, draining all of the fat away, but with that goes all the joy of life. Even though now extremely thin, the girl doesn't stop. Now she is more of a zombie, coming blindly to the fridge, that haunts her at night. In the moment of the last seduction by the fridge the Angel of United Bitches of Slimbuttlandia comes to her with a royal invitation to visit the Kingdom and to participate in a royal ceremony. What is this ceremony? Are the Skinny Buttangels that lovely and harmless as they try to appear? Which God do they praise? Is there a way back from The United Bitches of Slimbuttlandia if anything goes slightly off track?

Combining animation, live action and archive footage, this personal documentary shows the director's life growing up in Latvia during the Soviet era. Ilze, a little girl who is obsessed with WWII stories, lives under the totalitarian boot of the Soviets and encounters the many menaces and horrors of an authoritarian state. A vividly told anti-war autobiography.

A group of factory workers become obsessed with a hill. They let loose on the marshy earth, succumbing to their strange desires. The hill watches them closely, commenting on their activities like a deranged poet.
Good and evil, utopia and dystopia, narrative, and post narrative collide in a mortal battle to entertain the audience.

November 2015. Violette's parents are killed in the Paris terror attacks. She is sent to live with her uncle, a gruff man she hardly knows, who is a caretaker at the Versailles chateau. Little does Violette realize that in this intimidating place she will find unexpected refuge and a new family.

A cute reimagination of Greek mythology. A small minotaur, his Mum Medusa, a Cyclops delivery and the neighbours the Grey Sisters live their lives and solve their problems in today's world. Medusa really does have serious dating problems, who knew?

Somewhere in Eastern Europe due to an accident in a laboratory, the hero gains superpowers that he does not want. The hero does not want to be a superhero, to save the world from villains, he wants to live as before without changing anything. The situation is complicated by the fact that while he gains the awareness of his power, it causes problems in his everyday life.

Our most important internal motivation remains to satisfy our needs. In four episodes that are interconnected but distinct from each other, the question was what would happen if our needs were changed, shifted in time, able to adjust to our agenda, or if we could influence them.
Nestor, a man with several obsessive-compulsive behaviours lives in an unstable houseboat which never stops oscillating.
Four people each tell the story of their first time. All their stories have one thing in common: it's never like the first time! Based on documentary interviews.

Grindin' is a music video for Nobody Beats The Drum, A Dutch electro collective for whom visuals are as integral a part of the performance as the pounding beats they unleash. The stop-motion film is based around an intensely choreographed sequence of four thousand photographs and plays with the boundaries of sound, music and perspective.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Two Decades of Dutch Animation)

films.syn: A film behind a horse. Obscuring the narrative. Self sabotage.
In Lisbon, a german married couple is about to get aboard the legendary n°28 tramway, but how should you react when the brakes let go and embark you on a vertiginous race... with a baby on board.
A one sighted pirate captain keeps going on a journey to get a treasor, everytime with a new crew of pirates as one sighted as he is.

Forced to return to his naturist roots, Willy bungles his way into noble savagery. Entirely made from wool, felt and textile, Emma De Swaef and Marc James Roels' short tells a story of life, death and rebirth with wobbly thighs, vomit, breastfeeding, space travel and bunny rabbits - all against the backdrop of a nudist colony. Oh Willy... reads as a surrealist story about loneliness, grief and a soft little guy tossed around by life. De Swaef & Roels create a universe where its inhabitants and building blocks are allowed their imperfections.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Two Decades of Dutch Animation)
Officially selected (section: Country in Focus: Belgium)

films.syn: While his wife believes him at a coroporate seminar in Paris, Jean-Luc is sitting un a boat moving in the bayou somewhere in Louisiana. He has an appointment with the voodoo wizard Richardson. This wizard is know for solving all the problems.

A feared trio of high school delinquents, despite having no skill, money or even a full set of drums, decide to channel their inner garage rockers. Based on a manga, On-Gaku: Our Sound is an infectious deadpan comedy on the potency of music featuring punk rock aesthetics, Krautrock and an incredible mixture of visual and musical styles. A glorious cacophony.

An animated extravaganza of plastic collected from beaches, roadsides, attics and junk shops. This is an elegy to a love affair that has gone sour, a fond farewell to that most beautiful material that has enslaved our planet: plastic.
pan·​dic·​u·​la·​tion / pan-ˌdik-yə-ˈlā-shən /n The act of stretching oneself (often accompanied by yawning)

Deforestation, pollution, overpopulation. How long can man continue this before biodiversity has disappeared? The short film Paradise Lost visualizes in a unique and poetic way, how we destroy nature. In this film, “the light” is the main character confronting the viewers with their own reflection.
Patchwork Spider has a problem: he wants to play music on his web, but the music sounds bad! Will the Patchwork Pals find a way to help him?

Young Pilar and her friend Baldr have barricaded themselves from whatever it is that threatens them. One day, their safe haven is once more disturbed and they catch and kill the dangerous intruder: a wild and huge chamois-like beast. Pilar connects with it and this releases her inner animal that has been yearning to break free.

There is an unusual garden in a dark cave cultivated by a lonely man. One day, while he is pruning the plants he finds a little boy in a pot. The child’s nails are just as long as the offshoots of a plant.
A boy is suffering from a polka-dot disease on his arms since he can remember. Encountering some peculiar events, he discovers a hidden connection between the disease and a religious group.
Make popcorn – one at a time.
Julie can't fit into her school. The arrival of Emile, an autistic child, will change the game...

PUZZLE is an independent animation short film using hand-drawn style to express the initial cognition of gender, and the influence about her parents' divorce during director's childhood, . The director visualized her abstract feelings by drawing things related to her childhood such as goldfish, flower and the peach tree in her backyard as special metaphors.
The Queen of dots is also a queen of Instagram and Tumblr. Completed 02022020. Love forever.

In this tale of lost innocence a boy and girl find an idol in the stomach of a rabbit. Its magical abilities lead to riches. The vintage children's book style is inspired by a selection of 1950s educational stickers that director Run Wrake found in a thrift store. A retro and adult fairytale.
Three Renees go on a quest to find God, who is also Renee. As they travel the hills and valleys of Renee, they discover all the great joys, trials, and mysteries of being Renee.

15 have passed and Roberto is still in love with his neighbor, but she prefers to hide ashamed of her body. With his art and an old clothesline as the only ways of communication, Roberto has a plan to push his beloved for face her monsters at once.
In a heavily polluted world, a young woman mourns the disappearance of animal species. When she falls ill due to a bacterial infection, nature appears to send her a message in her hallucinations.

The salmon want to reproduce. While the salmon men are swimming upstream in a testosterone-driven race, the women at the source of the river indulge themselves in a fertility dance. But the roles aren’t set as clearly as the men expect.

Influenced by the intersections of hair, femininity and personal identity, Scalp Deep is a quick and intelligent animated short that captures the struggles of a young African woman as she navigates the expectations of others after she makes the decision to commit to a new look.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Two Decades of Dutch Animation)

films.syn: Drawn directly on film, both the animation and the soundtrack are abstract. Scratch is an intriguing conversation of sounds and images.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Two Decades of Dutch Animation)

films.syn: When nobody sees you, you seem to disappear. Only when you fall, you seem to belong, just for a little while.
The boy is swept up and gets lost in the parade pouring into the room.
A shy seventeen-year-old boy dreams of the girl he can spy on from the roof where he works as a roofer. His uncivilized macho colleagues poke hardhanded fun at him.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Two Decades of Dutch Animation)

films.syn: Sushi and Toppings show off their tenderness and juiciness to attract customers. Midway, Sushi gets a rude awakening about the harsh and brutal truth about his life and reflects upon it. Eventually, Sushi accepts his tragic fate.
no one can hear you when your floating and struggling through a midst of thick mash potato esque substance and colours in a constant state of unhappy happyness.

Shooom, a baby owl, hatches just as a storm turns the bayou surrounding her tree upside down. No sooner has she fallen from her nest, then the little fledgling totters off into the mangrove, pushing a second egg from the brood along with her. Come hell or high water, she’s determined to find a mother... even if that mom turns out to be an alligator or a raccoon!
A journey into a series of abstract sequences about loneliness.

"Sirius" is the result of an improvisation exercise with the purpose of using the artist intuition as a starting point instead of a script or storyboard. The idea was to experiment with more a flexible intuitive process to do animation.

A lullaby before the great disaster. Two pigeons visit a zoo without animals, a snail measures his blood pressure at the doctor, in the CERN laboratory something has gone terribly wrong.Six moments from our age, like memories of the world we leave behind.
For ten years, I’ve pretended to make a movie out of my grandfather's Algerian war souvenirs. Today, I’m not sure I want to hear what he has to say...

A crow, Min-chul explores space to find a beak jewel which is the last part of a jewel statue modeled after himself. One day, he finds the beak gem on a remote planet. However, there was a shocking secret hidden in the jewel...!
A cow gets ready in the morning for work, but forgets to put on her distinctive traits.

Dutch director Paul Driessen crafted an intriguing line-drawn story in which spots come to life. Manipulated by their originator, they are ushered to their final destination in a neat black-and-white display.

Emmy (5 years old) has always dreamed of flying through the stars with his best friend GooRoo, the giant bear. A starry night, GooRoo and Emmy make acquaintance with a lovely tiny star that will help them learn about the nature of their friendship and how our dreams are sometimes closer than we thought.
When a football steward is forced to miss the actions of his all-time idol as his back must be to the field, he goes all out – despite his strict boss' hovering – to catch a glimpse of his hero.
About the greenhouse effect, commissioned by the Dutch Ministry of Environment.

Strange Occurrences: Bukit Bulabu is a fictional ghost documentary done in stop motion. The story takes place in Singapore and involves a Singaporean influencer, a German Professor and a Singaporean Auntie who is a “superstitions expert”. With the interviewees recounting their haunted experience at the rediscovered colonial bathroom atop Bukit Bulabu, an underlying family history unfolds.
Fully animated in TVPaint, this short features a hungry ring-tail lemur who is after delicious fruits. Unfortunately for him he's not the only forest critter with an appetite.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Two Decades of Dutch Animation)

films.syn: Supervenus is a timely critique on modern beauty standards in which a plastic surgeon creates a new goddess of beauty, or isn't he?
God is a single parent and amateur programmer. He’s working on project ‘Earth’ but never seems to get a break from the kids. One day though, he finally gets a breakthrough.

What will happen to the earth if there’s no solution to climate change and overpopulation? ‘Thanks, goodbye.’ is a short surreal 3D film that shows the fatefull future of the earth. The apocalytic image of the devastated planet and the sounds that show how vibrant it was on earth, create a surreal contrast in the film.
The battle within gives a look into the head of someone with an anxiety attack and is about the power, struggles and courage it requires to fight your fears.

films.t: The Boy With Quite a Long Pair of Arms
films.syn: Classic cartoon shows what you can do with long arms. Cleaning the windows on the first floor, for instance. Most people would know what to do with this gift, but the boy does not.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Two Decades of Dutch Animation)

films.syn: Women are lucky, they get to have the only organ in the human body dedicated exclusively for pleasure: the clitoris! In this humorous history lesson and educative animated anatomy class, you can discover how the organ has been misrepresented in the past and why Sigmund Freud is the Number One enemy of the clitoris.
In the Gironde estuary, a tragedy affects a species of crabs: they can't turn. Everything changes when they find a leader.
This short film underlines the value of culture.
In a desolate world a train is rushing to an unknown destination.
A snail invites a fat elephant to shelter from the rain. Unfortunately his shell is a bit too small. Based on a story by Toon Tellegen.

ap.sel: Officially selected (section: Two Decades of Dutch Animation)

films.syn: When John-Boris Keybusiness, a man overwhelmed by fear of flying, is forced to get on a plane, nothing happens as planned... Dun dun duuuuunnnn

Every day, each and every one of us produces garbage: at work, at school, at home, on a walk. Everywhere. The short film describes the journey of trash on the planet. The ending of the film leaves open the question: what is the final destination of garbage?

films.t: The Girl from the Porno Movie
films.syn: Music video for Hiob Dylan. The story is based on the urban legend about the girl from the porn movie which was working in the local supermarket.
Even a God might have to reincarnate to get rid of a pesky fly.

In the voiceover for this animated short, a young woman attempts to describe herself, casting her life in the ideal light that society expects. The film’s imagery, however, tells a different story, poignantly illustrating the intense anxiety that comes with the quest for perfection and the pursuit of happiness. A film that’s both funny and moving, and above all, profoundly human.

In a theatre, an owl schoolmaster tries to present the year-end kindergarten show. Unfortunately, the evening does not go as planned, because one unforeseen event after another occurs even before the curtain rises.

Egypt's first animated feature film follows an unwavering young warrior who plans to rescue the wives and children of deceased sea merchants that have been taken prisoner by pirates and King Daher the Great of Sindh.

The Land of Whim, the main character in the film, is a planet invented by the director. Animation is the image of a land ruling by a whim. Everything that exists on the planet is unobvious, chaotic, and changes its shapes and properties. Mutual penetration and transformation of forms, change of places of creatures and objects - these are words that can be used to describe the character of the film. Despite the apparent mess that prevails on the planet, it is a happy place - clear and pure colors prevail in it. The picture of the strange and fairy-tale reality created by the author is an explosion of joy and surrealism.

There is no explanation on the story behind it. There is no deeper thought or symbolism behind it. Like driving, listening to the music and looking at the landscape. All passes by. Third part of "The Instrument/The Fool / The Landscape" trilogy. (2013-2020) Images in th film are a hommage to paintings and life of Andrzej Wróblewski. The titular "Landscape" could be a view seen by "Blue Chauffeur".
With the departing of the last human on earth, we are ushered into a new era of life.

An observational animation exploring the behaviours and interactions of a diverse cross section of tired, drunk, disgruntled, joyous and riotous strangers, pushed together within the confines of the last train home.

films.t: The Little Bird and the Bees
films.syn: High above, the little bird enjoys the flowers of its maple tree. A mysterious humming that needs to be fathomed sends him on a journey into a magical world of flowers. Of course, the fiery red fox is soon on the little bird’s heels. Trailed by bad luck the fox makes acquaintance with the hard-working bees.

A Vietnamese girl grows up in a European town. As she gets used to what it means to be strange and at home at the same time, her family inevitably heads towards a fatal decision. Who will leave – who will stay? Whose home is where?

films.t: The Nose or the Conspiracy of Mavericks
films.syn: Anchored in Gogol's novella 'The Nose' and Shostakovich's opera of the same name, The Nose or Conspiracy of Mavericks offers a cheerful grim look at the follies of twentieth century Russia. It's an operatic, eclectic journey through Stalin's reign of terror using cut-out animation, hand-drawn art and archive footage.

A batshit crazy road movie leaning on the epic weirdness of exploding cows and a potential dairy nuclear disaster. The grandchildren come to the village of Old Man for a visit. Together they need to find their runaway cow before its udder gives in. Some problems arrive in the form of a despicable rural hipster, forest beasts, a lunatic bear in constipation and a weelchair-bound, chainsaw-wielding psychopath. The Lactopocalypse is coming!

The cartoon series unite three fairy-tales with the Wolf being an antihero - "Little Red Riding Hood", "The Wolf And Seven Goatlings", "The Three Little Pigs". They all are brought into the new reality with the vegan Wolf , smartphone mirrors and charmed Internet forest. Among the other characters there is Finik, the goatling. He has special peculiarities in his development and music talent.

Op een zomerdag kruisen de wegen van twee jongens zich op onverwachte wijze. Un jour d'été, les chemins de deux garçons se croisent de manière inattendue. On a summer day, the paths of two boys unexpectedly cross.

We are all immigrants. Some leave cities or countries, all of us leave our childhood. Like the Minotaur of mythology, we roam through personal labyrinths, carrying nothing but a suitcase of memories, a portable time capsule filled with assorted mementoes from a past we can no longer reach. The first fully animated film made using the encaustic-painting technique, The Physics of Sorrow, inspired by the novel by Bulgarian writer Georgi Gospodinov, tracks the outlines of an unknown man’s life as he sifts through memories of circuses, bubble-gum wrappers, first crushes, army service from his youth in communist Bulgaria, and an increasingly rootless and melancholic adulthood in Canada—all the while struggling to find home, family and self. Superbly drawn and animated by Academy Award® nominee Theodore Ushev (Blind Vaysha, Lipsett Diaries), each image in The Physics of Sorrow is a work of art, aptly evoking the mesmerizing existence of its nostalgic protagonist.

The camera flies over a desolate cosmic landscape and descends towards a procession of strange, possibly extraterrestrial creatures. The foreman of the group picks a suitable spot and the whole multiplying colony starts excavating a pit. What they excavate they eat and divide among their mem- bers, who increase in numbers and improve their mining methods. T
It's springtime

The Snail and the Whale follows the amazing journey of a tiny snail who longs to see the world and manages to hitch a ride on the tail of a huge humpback whale. When the whale gets beached in a secluded bay, it’s the little snail who has to save the day. A joyous, empowering story about the natural wonders of the world and discovering that no matter how small you are, you can make a difference.
In this grim and menacing tale, a man destroys the nest of an unknown creepy creature. But it's not the most horrible creature he will meet tonight.
An ageing witch needs a baby for a spell to make her young again. But when she brings home an infant princess things don't go to plan.
Under a gloomy sun, two characters look for adaptation.

There is a strong connection between parents and their child. A young woman leaves the parental home to see the world. But the world of her parents is so tightly connected with her that by leaving, she puts it at risk. It turns out that this connection can be also destructive.
You fly with no seat! That's the rule in the Turbobus. To get one is a hard day job for a young wolf on his turbo-journey to find real friendship.
A woman's quest for a public toilet. (India)

Op Netflix de serie ‘Letter for the King’. Uiteraard gebaseerd op het boek ‘Brief voor de Koning’ van Tonke Dragt uit 1962. Vertaald in meer dan 30 talen, waaronder Japans, Grieks en Koreaans, en wereldwijd meer dan 3 miljoen keer verkocht. Reden voor ons om de nu 89-jarige schrijfster en haar imposante oeuvre te eren. Aangezien er weinig beeld is van de schrijfster, is er een prachtige biografie
A celebration of anima.

Jeep is looking for the ultimate vacation spot; an idyllic island full of wilderness and beautiful tropical birds. Once arrived Jeep finds out that he is not the only adventurer. What started as an idyllic trip escalates quickly into a true tourist trap where no escape is possible.

In this very short film, the viewer is being invited to explore and navigate through the traces of an uncertain mind. The pictures are taken from the authors kitchen and room during the first lockdown in Tallinn, 2020.

Trusts and Estates is a hand-drawn animated satire adapted from a conversation overheard in a Santa Monic restaurant in 2011. Four lawyers engage in a bantering dinner conversation that quickly devolves into a grotesque and brutal comedy of cruelty, while depiction the hypocrisy of white-collar elitism.
A starving man is forced by ancient tradition to carry his elderly mother to the top of a mountain, to leave her there to die.
A deceased farmer is buried by his hated brother, the vicar. Worms inhabit the corpse, discovering they’ve full control over it. The dead farmer awakens...

films.syn: A girl asks herself many questions, faces her problems with some monsters, anger makes her turn into a wasp, mingles with her King underwater, cries exaggeratedly, turns all red and finally she grows, tall as a giant.
The Lord and the Devil are in Paradise, playing cards. The Devil, in the process of cheating, drops one of his cards onto the Earth. He sends his faithful dog to retrieve it.
In a version of Kolkata, India rendered unliveable by sea level rise, things take a dark turn when a family of climate change refugees are ambushed by a tiger on the flooded streets.
One of ten short films for climate change campaign "Warming Up"
Wash and Love

After his mother dies, Adam comes across some letters his parents exchanged years ago. This is an opportunity for him to find out more about his father, who he never knew. The juxtaposition of animated drawings and archival material takes us back forty years and enables us to uncover an extraordinary family secret.

From the director of worldwide phenomenon Your Name. comes this romantic fantasy about a high-school boy who has run away to Tokyo and befriends a girl who appears to be able to manipulate the weather. Your Name. comes this romantic fantasy about a high-school boy who has run away to Tokyo and befriends a girl who appears to be able to manipulate the weather. For many people death is an uncomfortable topic, so we teamed up with charity Marie Curie and Saatchi&Saatchi to create a campaign with a catchy tune and googly eyes aimed at encouraging people to start a conversation.
Slugs have a hard time keeping up with the pace of life in the city of insects. When a financial crisis hits, the industrious bees only see one solution…
Three wine loving women go for a night out but through their behavior the night gets out of hand in a most hilarious way.

films.syn: Seasonal animated abstractions on the Violin Concerto in F minor, RV 297 'Winter' by Antonio Vivaldi.
A personal myth of creation of a woman and her two ways to encounter a man.

films.t: Wood Child and Hidden Forest Mother
films.syn: Deep in the forest, a hunter encounters a strange creature he cannot kill.
One morning an eclectic mix of people face the everyday battle - such as work, school and dish-washing. As the day progresses, their relationships are tested and ultimately their capacity to cope.

Surrounded by several couples, a god becomes bored, because he is on his own and jealous of the others’ happiness. He breathes out, creating a whirlwind of molecules, which resolve into a flat disc. In its centre is a spinning axis, a single mountain. The creator places various elements on the disc to complete his work. He installs Yin and Yang, the man and the woman. The two of them try in vain t

A young Chukchi girl travels with her dog through the Siberian tundra to visit her grandmother. Soon they find themselves in trouble, and will have to find a way to survive in the harsh wilderness. The reconnection of not only the modern and the traditional, but also of man and nature, lies at the heart of this homage to indigenous peoples of the North.

A figure is stuck on a lonely journey, but then another figure becomes visible. Their courses seem to be crossing, and after nervous and enthusiastic anticipation follows an intense encounter. But then the figures drift apart again, forced to continue their solitary courses.

films.t: Zara and the Others: Miss Miss
films.syn: The girls in Zara's class want to arrange a "Miss-competition". Zara doesn't know what that is, but they say that they'll find out who the prettiest girl in class is. Zara takes out her finest dress, but is as scared as she is excited: What if she bleeds noseblood on it...? Zara's quirky family thinks it's going to be a lot of fun to compete. With them tagging along, what could possibly go wrong?

When a chase for a delicious dragonfly goes awry, a frog finds himself on a journey towards higher levels of amphibian consciousness, ultimately leading him down the rabbit hole to face his worst fears.

A little girl melancholically reflects on her last summer with her father at his funeral. Set on a small island in Japan where director Honami Yano was born and raised, the short explores the relationship between the death of her father and the bomb storage in the mountain behind the family house.

If you think about the word "body", what do you see? There are many definitions that you can give to the word, right?! This playful and philosophical short is not just about human bodies, but also animal bodies, fruiting bodies, celestial bodies, metaphorical bodies... A voice-over fond of puns drives you through the life of many of that bodies, and their common destiny.

With dry humour and structured as a series of dark, depressing vignettes drawn in stark black and white, and to a soundtrack of mournful jazz, this short is a set of confessions ("I don't feel empathy", "I don't feel that I can save anyone", "I don't feel anything when I look at works of art", ...) anchored in fear, confusion, numbness, and anxiety.

Watch out!! A large pudding is threatening the city! Wait - whut? - back up... After Ronin neglects to clear up her dropped groceries, they start to mix and bubble, transforming into a small pudding. Whilst this initially seems odd, for Ronin, it is easily ignorable. Over the next few days, the pudding grows bigger and bigger. Uh-oh... Can she continue to ignore it?

Spirited away, well sort of! Based on interviews, A Sip of Water explores the role of shamanism in Korean culture by putting a female shaman (and her relation to both gods and the common people) centre stage. Shamans are considered extraordinary as they bridge the gap between the world of men and the world of gods. Director Hyuna Cho is one of the few to turn their focus on the shamans themselves, as they mostly serve others. A soothing film with the look of modernized traditional art.

Right at the edge of political, meditative and hopeful video-art and animation, there is this moving piece of cinema that has the look of a delicate oil painting. We see the outlines of an abandoned village. Decay sets in. A village, like a human being, is born out of love. A village, like a human being, is ruined, if left without love and care.

In this Argentinian music video three characters tell the story of Alpapuyo, that enclosure or thick low fog that covers the mountain. And each with their fears and concerns, run from the unknown. A feast for the eyes!

Yoriko Mizushiri is one of the most distinctive voices in the world of animation. Always soft, sensual and sensorial, her films stimulate the senses. In 2020, she directed the official festival trailer for the 30th World Festival of Animated Film - Animafest Zagreb.

Yoriko Mizushiri is one of the most distinctive voices in the world of animation. Always soft, sensual and sensorial, her films stimulate the senses. Her latest short again offers new perspectives on our body. Eerily, the film combines unpredictable forms, surprising geometries, textures and sounds to craft a unique creation.

"I want to be anywhere but here, and in anytime but now." Maitry Rao's short is a unique and poetic metacommentary film about wanting to go places and see new face, but being prevented from doing so by the pandemic. The narrator unravels a bittersweet resolution in the self-reflexive filmmaking process as we dive deeper into her dreamscape, created with the game Tilt Brush, which lets you paint in three-dimensional space inside virtual reality.

A true animated film about an invented archipelago. Tapping into the soul of a homeland, Felix Dufour-Laperrière's Archipel is an impressionistic travelogue that journeys into the real and invented Quebec of yesterday and today. Don't expect a dull, informative documentary on the mainly Francophone province in Canada. This is a stunning, lyrical, and free-spirited showcase of 12 animators working in 12 different styles, evoking a notebook of interior wanderings along the St. Lawrence River and its thousands of islands towards the Atlantic. Through an intimate and enigmatic dialogue between a woman and a man who questions her existence, director Dufour-Laperrière builds a reflection on what makes a territory, whether it is real or symbolic. Said to be inspired by Sans Soleil by the French film essay pioneer Chris Marker, the Quebec director has always shown an interest in the intricate tension between narrative and form, and in the rhythm of animation, words and music. His latest feature excavates the Canadian ground and heritage, and evolves into a whimsical semi-fictional documentary on a real or dreamed country, or something in between. Combining image and word - even Innu poet Joséphine Bacon is heard reading one of her works - Archipel asks us what makes a land into a community and invites us on an imaginary journey, full of poetry, raw archive footage (incorporated in the animation), swirling words, old maps and photographs, and hi(stories) of struggle and pain. "Do you exist?", the male asks the female voice. Maybe it doesn't even matter. The film voyage is real. And we get to experience it.
